entities.name: Kunio Katō
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Kunio Katō (加藤久仁生) is a Japanese animator known for the short film La Maison en Petits Cubes which won the 2008 Academy Award for Best Animated Short Film. He also created The Diary Of Tortov Roddle, a surrealistic dream adventure.
